commit_message:
[res] Validate package ID range in LoadedArsc

The package ID in a RES_TABLE_PACKAGE_TYPE chunk is 32-bit,
but resource IDs only allocate 8 bits for the package ID.
If a malformed ARSC file has a package ID greater than 255, it
could lead to unexpected behavior or overflow when being parsed.

This change adds a range check to ensure the package ID is within the
valid range during loading.
